svg.text: Class robot — stick, two pots, two servos, motors, status LED (FNK0046)
Stick steers, a pot per servo, LED reports
1. Driver and joystick first, as robot-drive.yml shows.
2. Pots: left leg → GND, right leg → 3V3, middle leg (the
3. Servos: brown → GND, red → 5V, orange → GPIO 15, then GPIO
4. Motor leads: left → OUT1/OUT2, right → OUT3/OUT4.
5. Status LED: GPIO 2 → 220 Ω → LED, then the cathode to GND.
6. Power the driver from the 9V clip (12V and GND), sharing
7. 9V clip → the driver's 12V and GND (not shown).
Drive: OUT1/OUT2 = left motor, OUT3/OUT4 = right. Each servo

The status LED shares GPIO 2 with the onboard LED, so both
Code: pot = ADC(Pin(34)); servo = PWM(Pin(15), 50); duty =
